note: The curriculum review board's decisions, as one canonical file — docs/BOARD_PACKET.md and the data-quality dashboard (docs/DATA_QUALITY.md) both read it, replacing the earlier convention of stating a decision's status in prose across several documents by hand. Fields: id (stable, never reused), date (ISO, null before a real sitting records one), motion (what the board is asked), outcome ("proposed" | "adopted" | "rejected" | "open" — "open" is for a question with no drafted motion yet), signed_by (names/roles once minuted, empty until then), and an optional decision-specific note. tools/normalize_blocks.py's credential_decision_ready() gates a promotion's credential correction on outcome=="adopted" ONLY when that promotion names this decision's id via a `"decision"` key on its track; a promotion naming no decision id is unaffected (see BD-1) — this file records status, it does not retroactively gate correction already shipped before the mechanism existed. tools/cohort_report.py lists every decision whose outcome is not "adopted" as open, for the board's agenda.

decisions.motion: Adopt the 24 proposed credential names correcting the bare level word "Practitioner" left on 1,228 rows (24 tracks, five community packs) by the v0.1.0 import — docs/DATA_REVIEW.md Finding 6, the full list in docs/BOARD_PACKET.md.
decisions.note: Applied through the pipeline since v0.52.0 as the one deliberate, counted exception to fill-empty-only (data/promotions/*.json carry the names; tools/normalize_blocks.py applies them). This decision predates the decision-gate mechanism and does not gate that application — the correction is unconditional and stays that way regardless of this record's outcome. Flipping this to "adopted" once a real board sits records the fact; it changes no dataset output.
